subject: Hosted API pricing & SOC 2 evidence for volume commit
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintech.io>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintech.io>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing questions + security gating

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile and per-token cost look promising for our timeline. Before we move toward a larger commit I wanted to confirm a couple of items: 

- Can you share the tiered per-token pricing for usage-based commitments (e.g., 5M, 25M, 100M qps/tokens per month) and what triggers the rebate/discount?
- Our procurement requires a signed DPA and SOC 2 Type II evidence before any pricing commitments/POs are finalized. Is that something Redwood requires as well for volume pricing? If so, what evidence do you provide and how long does it typically take to produce?

We’re aiming to decide on a vendor by Feb 5; happy to share expected uplift numbers if that helps you draft a proposal.

Appreciate it —
Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Platform Engineering, FinTech.io
emily.zhang@fintech.io | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: none
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintech.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing questions + security gating

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the clear list. Very reasonable timelines on your side — we can work with that. High level answers below; I attached a short PDF with the pricing tiers and a draft MOU for your procurement team.

1) Tiered per-token structure (hosted API, USD, list prices):
   - Tier A: 0-5M tokens/mo — $0.015 per 1k tokens
   - Tier B: 5M-25M tokens/mo — $0.010 per 1k tokens
   - Tier C: 25M-100M tokens/mo — $0.007 per 1k tokens
   - Commitment rebate: applied retroactively on monthly usage when a 12-month committed-spend tier is signed (rebate scales with tier).

2) Eligibility gating: For enterprise-level committed pricing (any negotiated discount beyond Tier A list), we do require execution of our standard DPA and receipt of SOC 2 Type II evidence or equivalent audit attestation before finalizing the pricing addendum. Practically:
   - Signed DPA + SOC 2 Type II report uploaded to our secure portal = pricing addendum countersigned within 5 business days, subject to legal review.
   - If SOC 2 is in progress but not complete, we can accept an interim SOC 2 report plus a customer-facing remediation plan + timeline, but discounts are limited until full evidence is provided.

3) Timeline & next steps:
   - I attached a proposed MOU and our pricing tiers (see FT_Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_Q1.pdf).
   - If you can share the procurement checklist and any specific SOC 2 evidence requirements (e.g., Type II period, trust services criteria), I’ll loop in our legal team to confirm.

I’m copying Marissa (your account exec) and our legal contact Lauren for the SOC 2 / DPA coordination. If it helps, we can send an escrow of the SOC 2 Type II to your security mailbox or provide a read-only Drive link.

Next step: propose we schedule a 30-min pricing + compliance sync on Jan 21. Does that work for you?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-3940

Attachments: FTI_Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_Q1.pdf; Proposed_MOU_FinTech-Redwood.docx
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing questions + security gating

Marcus / Marissa —

Looping in a quick checklist for FinTech.io so we’re aligned on what we need before countersigning any pricing addendum that references a commitment: 

- Fully executed DPA (standard Redwood template acceptable) with required security appendices keyed to encrypted logs and data retention.
- SOC 2 Type II report covering the most recent 12-month period; or, if unavailable, an interim Type II report plus a signed remediation plan and timeline.
- Penetration test summary and patching cadence (redacted OK).
- Confirmation of KMS/HSM use for customer keying (if they plan to manage keys).

If FinTech.io needs an extended signature flow (legal/finance approval steps), we can accommodate but must map the PO and pricing addendum effective date to the DPA execution date. Also recommend including a clause that allows Redwood to provide SOC 2 evidence via a secure link rather than attaching to contracts.

I’ll prepare our DPA + pricing addendum template and share a DocuSign link once Marcus confirms the final tier and rebate.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2_Checklist_Request.xlsx
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintech.io>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintech.io>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing questions + security gating

Marcus —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the materials. We reviewed the tiers with finance; the 25M tier looks like the right target for our Q2 forecasts. A couple of clarifications before we book the DocuSign flow: 

- FinTech.io will need the SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending Dec 31, 2025. Can you provide the report or a secure read-only access by Jan 28?
- We can sign the DPA prior to producing the SOC 2 evidence, but we need a firm commitment that the negotiated rebate will be applied retroactively once SOC 2 Type II is received and accepted by our security team.

If both items are OK, we’ll get procurement ready and aim to sign the MOU/commitment by Feb 2. Please send the DocuSign link for the MOU + DPA once Lauren shares the templates.

Thanks —
Emily

---
Emily Zhang
Head of Platform Engineering, FinTech.io
